subject: Complaint regarding Lottery/Prize Scam involving fraudulent requests for processing fees
body:
To,
The Cyber Cell,
National Cybercrime Reporting Portal,

I am writing to report a fraudulent incident involving a Lottery/Prize Scam. 

Summary of Incident:
[Describe what happened in your words]

Scam Details:
Scam Type: Lottery/Prize Scam
Suspicious Phone Numbers: +91 63000 99120, +91 90000 00000
Suspicious UPI ID: kbc.claim@ybl
Amounts Involved: Rs 25,00,000, Rs 5,500

Red Flags Identified:
- Unsolicited prize notification
- Fake prize / lottery pattern
- Request for upfront processing fee to claim a prize
- Asks for an advance/processing fee
- Asks for payment to a personal UPI ID
- Request for sensitive Aadhaar number via WhatsApp
- Use of high-pressure tactics like 'Offer expires today'
- Urgency / threat words (pressure to act fast)
- Suspicious UPI ID

Loss Details:
Amount Lost: [Amount lost, if any]
Payment Method: [Payment method, e.g. UPI / card / bank transfer]
Transaction ID: [Transaction ID / UTR, if any]

I request you to kindly take immediate action to block the mentioned phone numbers (+91 63000 99120, +91 90000 00000), the suspicious UPI ID (kbc.claim@ybl), and to freeze the beneficiary bank account(s) associated with these details to prevent further fraud.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
[Your phone number]
[Date and time of incident]
